title: Speculative enquiry: graduate civil designer or engineer (Ballarat VIC)
content_text: No advertised vacancy. Careers page reads 'Want to work with us?' with a file upload form (max 15MB). Services: civil engineering, project planning, town planning, 2D flood modelling. Commercial projects page: Maddingly Village, McCormacks Road, West Maddingly (Stonehill development near Bacchus Marsh) and Unity Drive, Mount Duneed: 'The design comprises earthworks, stormwater drainage, road pavements, concrete kerbing, pedestrian footways, sewer and water reticulation. During the construction phase we performed the role of Superintendent to the Principal Civil construction contract and surveillance of the works.' About: founded by Chris Coughlan in 2002, offices in Ballarat.
apply_instructions: No advertised vacancy. Upload resume and cover letter through the 'Want to work with us?' form on https://www.axiomconsultingengineers.com.au/careers.
